flags.summary: A hero sent a foe over a map's open drop on their own turn in a story fight (Achievements.note_fight, from the fight's tally). A side flag for the castle's gargoyle; nothing in the main story reads it, and it stays set once it is.
A barrel of lamp oil burst in a story fight, whoever set it off and whoever it caught (Achievements.note_fight, from ObjectFire.bursts). A side flag; it stays set once it is.

A hero threw an improvised object (a chair, a stool, a crate, a thing lying about) in a story fight (Achievements.note_fight, from the fight's tally). A side flag for the camp's banter; it stays set once it is.
